onboarding.intro: Two quick choices and you're set. You can change both later in Settings.
onboarding.langHelp: The app is in English by default. Pick a language — others are AI-translated.
onboarding.langOtherHelp: Enter a 2-letter code (e.g. sv, ja). It's translated on your device once your AI engine is set up.
onboarding.langQueued: We'll translate the interface right after you set up an AI engine.
onboarding.engineHelp: The AI tailors your CVs and scans job listings. Pick how it runs.
onboarding.doneBody: Next: build your Profile (import an existing CV to start fast), then add job sources under Job Suggestions.

banner.engineNotReady: Welcome! To generate CVs and scan job listings, set up an AI engine in <settings>Settings</settings> — download the free local model, or add an OpenRouter API key.
banner.setupInstalling: Setting up the PDF engine (one-time, ~150 MB). Everything except PDF export works while this finishes.
banner.setupError: The PDF engine couldn't be set up: {{error}}. PDF export won't work until this is resolved.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter Connection
openrouter.help: OpenRouter routes requests to Claude, GPT-4, and other models via one API key. Get yours at <link>openrouter.ai/keys</link>.
openrouter.currentlySet: Currently set (ending {{preview}}). Enter a new key to replace it.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.help: Move to a new computer or keep a safe copy of your work. Export downloads a single .zip containing your profile & photo, settings, job sources & history, and every generated CV. On the new machine, install Job Coach and use Restore to load that file.
backup.confirmRestore: Restoring a backup replaces your profile, settings, job history and generated CVs on this computer with the contents of the backup (your API key is kept). This cannot be undone. Continue?
backup.note: Restoring replaces your profile, job history and generated CVs with the backup's contents — it does not merge. Your OpenRouter API key is never included in the export and is left untouched on restore.

language.title: Language
language.help: The language of the app's interface. English is the original; other languages are translated by your AI engine.
language.label: App language
language.otherHelp: Type a language name. It will be translated on-device by your AI engine — results may contain rough edges.
language.needEngineFirst: Set up an AI engine above before adding a new language.
language.badCode: Enter a 2-letter language code (e.g. sv, ja, ar).

prompts.title: Advanced — AI prompts
prompts.help: These are the exact instructions sent to the AI. The defaults work well — only edit them if you want to change how CVs are written or how job listings are filtered. You can always reset to the default.
prompts.langPlaceholderError: The prompt must contain the {lang_name} placeholder — it tells the AI which language to write in.
prompts.cvHelp: Sent when tailoring a CV. Your profile and the job listing are added automatically below it. {lang_name} is replaced with the output language — it must stay in the prompt.
prompts.extractHelp: Picks which of a page's links are real job openings. The list of links found on the page is added automatically below it.
prompts.filterHelp: Decides which new openings match you. The relevant parts of your profile are added automatically below it.

help.awards: Honours and awards — shown on your CV.

cv.title: CV Generator
cv.noCvsBody: Paste the URL of a job listing and the AI reads it, picks your most relevant experience, and writes a tailored CV — ready to preview, edit, and download as PDF.
cv.generatingHint: Reading the listing and tailoring your CV — usually about 30 seconds.
cv.needEngine: Generating needs a configured AI engine — set one up in Settings.
cv.generationFailedRestart: Generation failed — the server may have restarted. Check the history list below.
cv.noCvForJob: No CV found for that job yet — its generation may have failed. Use “Regenerate CV” on the Job Suggestions page to try again.

jobs.title: Job Suggestions
jobs.sourcesHelp: Add job-listing pages to watch. Finding new listings scans each for openings and filters them against your profile.
jobs.noSources: No sources yet — paste a careers-page URL above.
jobs.scanFailedRestart: Scan failed — the server may have restarted.
jobs.needEngine: Scanning needs a configured AI engine — set one up in Settings.
jobs.noSuggestionsNoSources: Add a job-listing page above, then find new listings — openings that match your profile will appear here.
jobs.noSuggestionsHasSources: Run “Find new listings” — openings that match your profile will appear here with a short reason.
jobs.acceptTitle: Generates a tailored CV for this job and opens it in the CV Generator
jobs.regenerateTitle: Run the CV generation for this opening again

cveditor.refreshDesc: Re-render with your saved edits and the latest design settings. Free, instant.
cveditor.pullProfileHasPlan: Re-render from the stored tailoring plan using your current profile data. Free.
cveditor.pullProfileNoPlan: Re-tailor from the job listing using your current profile (runs the AI).
cveditor.retailorHasUrl: Re-run the AI against the job listing (~30 seconds, uses a few cents of credit).
cveditor.retailorNoUrl: No job URL stored for this CV, so it can't be re-tailored.
cveditor.retailorPrompt: Re-run the AI for the {{lang}} version. Keep your edited summary and bullet points, or start fresh?
cveditor.keepEdits: Keep my edits, regenerate the rest
cveditor.relangTooltipHasUrl: Regenerate this CV in another language (re-runs the AI, ~30s)
cveditor.relangTooltipNoUrl: No job URL stored, so the language cannot be changed
cveditor.reRunningNote: Re-running the AI — this takes about 30 seconds.
cveditor.photoDisabled: The Photo section is disabled because no photo is on file.
cveditor.editHelp: Edit the summary and bullet points below; Save all edits applies everything at once. Select text and press ⌘/Ctrl+B or ⌘/Ctrl+I to make it bold or italic. Drag the handle to reorder bullets.
cveditor.aiSummaryTooltip: Ask the AI to write a new summary based on your profile and this job
cveditor.unsavedChangesNote: Unsaved changes — saves the summary and all job bullets.
cveditor.editingUnavailable: Editing isn't available for this CV yet — use Update CV… → Ask the AI to re-tailor to create an editable tailoring plan.
